source_note: The 15 names originated in a founder inventory email. This registry treats that email as a hypothesis and uses repository paths, not the email, as implementation evidence.
boundaries: A present file is not proof of production readiness, customer adoption, external validation, or economic value.
A local test is evidence of bounded software behavior only.
Trading and sports lanes remain research and paper-only until prospective, after-cost evidence and applicable legal controls pass.
Hardware, XR, identity, energy, and smart-city claims remain conceptual or simulation-bound until independent domain validation exists.
Final government certifications, signatures, prices, uploads, and submissions remain human-controlled.

engines.name: LumaTrader
engines.safe_description: Paper-only market research, model comparison, runtime controls, and replayable decision evidence.
engines.payer: Quant research teams, fintech labs, and model-governance groups
engines.bounded_offer: A fixed-scope paper/replay evaluation with declared baselines, costs, abstention rules, and a reproducible evidence packet.
engines.revenue_route: Paid research engagement first; subscription only after prospective after-cost evidence and operational controls pass.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Research subcontract, model-governance pilot, or non-dilutive validation award.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective paper protocol beats a named baseline after fees and slippage without breaching risk or reconciliation gates.
engines.claim_boundary: No alpha, profitability, institutional readiness, or live-capital claim.
engines.next_build: Publish a buyer-safe paper/replay API contract and a clean prospective scorecard.

engines.name: Kraken Sentinel / LumaSniper
engines.safe_description: Crypto-market telemetry, guarded signal research, and paper-execution controls.
engines.payer: Digital-asset research teams and boutique quantitative labs
engines.bounded_offer: A private paper-trading instrumentation and reconciliation sprint.
engines.revenue_route: Research services first; no signal subscription before a prospective protocol passes.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Fintech research subcontract or controlled-risk tooling pilot.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective after-fee paper results, deterministic kill controls, and complete ledger reconciliation.
engines.claim_boundary: No live trading authority, profit, return, or investment-advice claim.
engines.next_build: Add Kraken-specific tests, a read-only demo feed, and a signed paper-ledger verifier.

engines.name: LumenGov Grant Factory
engines.safe_description: Opportunity qualification, evidence assembly, conformance checks, and human-controlled submission preflight.
engines.payer: Startups, research teams, grant consultants, and small government contractors
engines.bounded_offer: A 30-day design-partner pilot that monitors opportunities and prepares reviewable submission packets without autonomous certification or submission.
engines.revenue_route: Managed pilot, then organization subscription with seats, monitoring, evidence storage, and optional preflight support.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Small-business workflow modernization contract or innovation-management grant.
engines.acceptance_gate: Against the buyer's current workflow, reduce verified preparation latency or conformance defects while preserving source and approval controls.
engines.claim_boundary: No guaranteed eligibility, submission, award, savings, or portal authority.
engines.next_build: Package one tenant-isolated pilot with buyer-owned baselines, official-source freshness checks, and exportable receipts.

engines.name: Lumen Infrastructure Sentinel
engines.safe_description: Infrastructure baseline, drift, anomaly, and evidence-packet tooling.
engines.payer: Data-center operators, utilities, hospital IT, telecom teams, and managed-service providers
engines.bounded_offer: A buyer-authorized baseline and drift audit on one bounded system with a pre-agreed alert and evidence contract.
engines.revenue_route: Fixed-price assessment followed by a monitoring and evidence-retention subscription.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Resilience pilot, infrastructure-monitoring subcontract, or energy reliability research award.
engines.acceptance_gate: Detect declared injected or historical failure modes at an agreed false-alert rate using buyer-authorized data.
engines.claim_boundary: No outage prevention, realized savings, field validation, or safety-control claim.
engines.next_build: Add an injection-test harness, operator acceptance receipt, and deployment-independent health contract.

engines.name: LumaScout
engines.safe_description: Source-receipted artist and creator discovery shortlists with forward outcome tracking.
engines.payer: Labels, artist-management teams, agencies, and creator-economy research groups
engines.bounded_offer: A private discovery sprint that produces a pre-registered shortlist and tracks forward outcomes against a transparent popularity baseline.
engines.revenue_route: Paid shortlist sprint followed by a team watchlist and alert subscription.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Creative-industry analytics pilot or data-rights-compliant research partnership.
engines.acceptance_gate: Forward shortlist outcomes improve on a declared popularity baseline using licensed or permitted data.
engines.claim_boundary: No hit prediction, label adoption, or undocumented cross-platform data-rights claim.
engines.next_build: Add deterministic fixture tests, source-rights metadata, and a forward-outcome receipt.

engines.name: Sports Harmonic Edge
engines.safe_description: Sports-odds ingestion and research scoring under explicit uncertainty and paper-only controls.
engines.payer: Sports media research desks and analytics teams
engines.bounded_offer: A historical and prospective research report comparing declared scoring methods to simple market baselines.
engines.revenue_route: Research report or analytics tooling license only after prospective evidence and legal review.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Sports-data methods research or media analytics subcontract.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective calibration and ranking metrics beat declared simple baselines without hidden selection.
engines.claim_boundary: No betting advice, guaranteed edge, profit, or consumer wagering automation.
engines.next_build: Add licensed fixtures, calibration tests, a prospective lock, and a non-wagering demonstration.

engines.name: CrowdFund Radar
engines.safe_description: Campaign discovery and evidence-linked research queue tooling.
engines.payer: Product scouts, trend-research teams, and angel-network analysts
engines.bounded_offer: A campaign-research sprint that ranks public opportunities with source links and explicit uncertainty.
engines.revenue_route: Analyst service first; watchlist subscription after source rights and forward validation are established.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Innovation-scouting services or ecosystem research contract.
engines.acceptance_gate: A pre-registered ranking shows useful forward lift over a simple campaign-popularity baseline.
engines.claim_boundary: No investment recommendation, campaign quality guarantee, or return claim.
engines.next_build: Add fixtures, tests, source-terms metadata, a public-safe dashboard, and forward labels.

engines.name: Cyber Forensics Assist
engines.safe_description: Prototype evidence-component scoring and investigation chronology support.
engines.payer: Incident-response consultants, legal support teams, and internal security analysts
engines.bounded_offer: A synthetic-data workflow review for evidence organization and report consistency.
engines.revenue_route: Professional-services prototype before any software subscription.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Cyber workflow research or digital-evidence tooling subcontract.
engines.acceptance_gate: On approved synthetic cases, improve reviewer agreement or chronology completeness without modifying source evidence.
engines.claim_boundary: No forensic conclusion, chain-of-custody certification, legal admissibility, or autonomous incident response.
engines.next_build: Separate the cold-case demo from cyber use, add immutable source references, tests, and expert review.

engines.name: EchoForm Identity Engine
engines.payer: Future personal-AI, simulation, and identity-platform research partners
engines.bounded_offer: Architecture workshop only after privacy, consent, threat-model, and data-minimization requirements are defined.
engines.revenue_route: Research or architecture services; no subscription until a consent-first prototype exists.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Privacy-preserving digital-twin research grant or university collaboration.
engines.acceptance_gate: A consent-first prototype passes privacy, deletion, provenance, and identity-consistency tests.
engines.claim_boundary: No biometric certification, medical inference, identity proof, or continuity-of-person claim.
engines.next_build: Create a non-biometric reference implementation with revocable consent and deletion tests.

engines.name: Luma XR Command Room
engines.safe_description: Prototype launch and interface assets for immersive system-state visualization.
engines.payer: Simulation labs, training teams, museums, and enterprise demonstration groups
engines.bounded_offer: A fixed-scope visualization prototype using non-sensitive sample telemetry.
engines.revenue_route: Custom implementation services, then an SDK license after usability validation.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Human-factors, simulation, or training-interface grant and subcontract work.
engines.acceptance_gate: Users complete declared monitoring tasks with acceptable error, latency, and comfort measures.
engines.claim_boundary: No operational command authority, training efficacy, motion-sickness prevention, or safety certification.
engines.next_build: Restore the missing demo asset, add deterministic sample telemetry, and run usability tests.

engines.name: Smart City Node Engine
engines.payer: Future municipal, utility, and telecom research partners
engines.bounded_offer: No paid software offer yet; only a requirements and simulation-scoping workshop.
engines.revenue_route: Research services before any product or subscription.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Smart-community, edge-computing, or infrastructure-resilience research grant.
engines.acceptance_gate: A simulator and declared baseline demonstrate reproducible latency, resilience, or resource-allocation improvement.
engines.claim_boundary: No city deployment, critical-infrastructure control, latency, resilience, or savings claim.
engines.next_build: Implement a small deterministic edge-routing simulator with baseline and failure-injection tests.

engines.name: FlowForm Hardware Engine
engines.safe_description: Simulation and audit tooling for geometry-informed routing concepts.
engines.payer: Future aerospace, robotics, EV, and electronics R&D teams
engines.bounded_offer: A simulation-only comparison against declared geometry and routing baselines.
engines.revenue_route: Research engagement or IP option; no hardware license before independent bench evidence.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: SBIR/STTR, lab collaboration, or OEM research subcontract.
engines.acceptance_gate: Pre-registered simulation and then independent bench tests beat named baselines on declared measures.
engines.claim_boundary: No physical thermal, electromagnetic, battery, structural, or manufacturing-performance claim.
engines.next_build: Freeze one geometry, comparator, metric set, mesh, solver settings, and independent bench plan.

engines.name: Energy Harmonization Engine
engines.safe_description: Energy-data evidence pipeline and simulation research component.
engines.payer: Utilities, facility operators, energy researchers, and government laboratories
engines.bounded_offer: A buyer-authorized forecast replay or evidence-quality assessment on one declared decision.
engines.revenue_route: Validation service first; monitoring subscription only after operator acceptance.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: DOE, EPRI, utility, or resilience research pilot.
engines.acceptance_gate: On operator-approved data, meet declared accuracy, calibration, timeliness, and economic-conversion rules against named baselines.
engines.claim_boundary: No nuclear control, field validation, outage savings, or universal harmonic superiority.
engines.next_build: Complete one prospective EIA settlement lane and one operator-defined replay.

engines.name: World Model Engine
engines.payer: Enterprise strategy, research, and government analytics teams
engines.bounded_offer: A scoped scenario model using one buyer-owned decision, source set, baseline, and uncertainty register.
engines.revenue_route: Modeling services before any platform subscription.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Cross-sector resilience, policy-modeling, or decision-support research contract.
engines.acceptance_gate: Reproduce declared scenarios and improve a named decision metric without hidden data or hindsight.
engines.claim_boundary: No complete world model, operational prediction, policy authority, or cross-sector superiority claim.
engines.next_build: Narrow to one decision problem and add source contracts, fixtures, tests, and calibrated uncertainty.

engines.name: LumaCore Orchestrator
engines.safe_description: Routing, sequencing, health, and evidence-pack assembly across bounded subsystems.
engines.payer: Internal operations first, then enterprise evidence and workflow teams
engines.bounded_offer: A private workflow-orchestration pilot with fail-closed approvals and replayable receipts.
engines.revenue_route: Implementation engagement followed by an enterprise orchestration and evidence-retention license.
engines.contract_or_grant_route: Workflow modernization, trustworthy-AI, or evidence-governance subcontract.
engines.acceptance_gate: Complete a declared workflow with fewer verified defects or less preparation time while preserving every approval and abstention rule.
engines.claim_boundary: No autonomous legal, procurement, financial, trading, or safety-critical authority.
engines.next_build: Restore public gateway health, add tenant isolation, and expose one stable governed-workflow API.
